name: Pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ)
short: Human safety data are small and short-term: no adverse events in a 12-week trial of 64 healthy adults aged 40 to 79; a review calls for long-term safety studies.
text: In a 12-week randomised, placebo-controlled trial of PQQ disodium salt in 64 healthy Japanese adults aged 40 to under 80, no adverse events were observed. In a small crossover study in 10 adults who took PQQ in a drink, standard clinical blood measures such as cholesterol and glucose stayed normal and were not altered. A 2024 review stated that no toxicity or genotoxicity has been reported in various studies, while noting that its long-term effectiveness and safety still need to be assessed. The human studies are small and short. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
